scenes.name: bracket_palimpsest
scenes.probe: (() => { const box = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height]; }; return [...document.querySelectorAll('.view-overlays .bracket-match')].map((b) => ({ color: getComputedStyle(b).backgroundColor, under: [...b.parentElement.children].map((c) => c.className), box: box(b) })); })()
